title: Portuguese Quesadilla
description: A twist on traditional quesadillas, this Portuguese-inspired dish combines melted cheese with quick-cooked ingredients. Perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add the quick-cooked chorizo and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the Portuguese cheese and stir until melted.
Place a quesadilla in the pan and spoon the cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Repeat with the remaining quesadilla and filling.
Cut into wedges and serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
